rv.q: Louis de Bernières adaptation that’s liable to bring a lump to the throat.

Until the end of August, the Harold Pinter theatre plays host to a stage adaptation of Louis de Bernières’ multi-award winning, World War II Greek Island romance, CAPTAIN CORELLI’S MANDOLIN and aside from a few minor gripes, it’s a beautifully realised affair. Madison Clare, Alex Mugnaioni and Members of the Company in Captain Corelli's Mandolin.
